shops.title: Shops
shops.description: One shop name per line, for example Walmart or Home Depot. The Actor looks for Store Actors whose title or name contains the shop name.

maxActorsPerShop.title: Max Actors to read per shop
maxActorsPerShop.description: How many Store listings to read for each shop, most popular first. A higher number is more complete for big shops like Amazon.

category.title: Store category
category.description: Apify Store category to search in. ECOMMERCE is the default. Note: the ECST coverage check only makes sense for ECOMMERCE.
